signal.rationale: The 5 Aug 2026 filing states a firm order from NKG Primus JV with total size INR 400 crore, equal to 167.8% of TTM revenue of INR 238.38 crore; the period runs to March 2027 or March 2028, so annual revenue is lower than the total. Prior disclosed orders were far smaller (largest INR 94.73 crore), so the order is not routine. The awarding entity is a domestic JV, not a group entity, and no disqualifier applies; PAT was INR 29 crore in FY26 and the company is not stressed.
